description: This is a test suite for the VoiceWakeManager's extractCommand method, including auxiliary functions for segment creation and transcript analysis.

classes.name: VoiceWakeManagerExtractCommandTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests to verify the behavior of VoiceWakeManager's extractCommand method.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNoTriggerFound
methods.description: Tests that extractCommand returns nil if no trigger word is present in the transcript.

methods.name: extractCommandTrimsTokensAndResult
methods.description: Tests that extractCommand correctly extracts and trims the command following the trigger.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenGapTooShort
methods.description: Tests that extractCommand returns nil if the gap after trigger is shorter than the minimum required.

methods.name: extractCommandReturnsNilWhenNothingAfterTrigger
methods.description: Verifies that extractCommand returns nil if there is no command after the trigger phrase.

methods.name: extractCommandIgnoresEmptyTriggers
methods.description: Ensures that empty or whitespace trigger strings are ignored in the extraction process.
